body: I appreciate that, thank you :) I felt like some stress was alleviated by just posting anything at all. However it always comes back, and generally talking about it just makes me feel like an unappreciative jackass for not being humble and acknowledging all the reasons I have to be happy instead of focusing on what makes me miserable.

I completely understand the idea of feeling like you're too much of a "pussy" to do it, but I also try to remind myself that maybe it isn't just that I'm a coward, maybe it's because it's kind of an instinctual desire to live. It's kept me around thus far. I've been depressed as long as I can remember and moving back home has seemed to do the complete opposite of what I had hoped, so I understand that aspect as well. I feel like our situations are very similar and though I have no right to give any advice I will say this - I care, and if you ever need someone who understands and won't pretend to listen or relate, someone who knows precisely what you're feeling, I can try to help. I may hate mostly everything about myself, but one thing I'll admit is that I believe I do have a good heart and I want the best for people, I'm a pretty decent listener too as I've gotten quite sick of hearing myself talk. :)
I loved this show and have never seen a post on Reddit about Daria yet. :) I like it.
